proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E631 (Sodium 5-Inosinate)
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E631 (disodium/sodium 5-inosinate) as Mushbooh (doubtful): it may be derived from meat extract, dried sardines, or microbiological fermentation, so the source must be verified — pork or non-halal-meat sourced E631 is not permissible.

researcherNote: E631 seeded zabiha grade 4 (widely avoided). SANHA mushbooh (meat extract/sardines/fermentation) — strict follower avoids unless a halal source is confirmed. One tier-1. (E631/lenient deliberately NOT staged: SANHA is the only clean tier-1 and a lenient cell needs two independent clearing sources; no solid tier-1 permissive E631 fatwa found — left pending rather than pad with a tier-3 blog.)
